# Rogers Communications Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results


Jul 22, 2026


TORONTO (July 22, 2026) – Rogers Communications Inc. (TSX: RCI.A and RCI.B; NYSE: RCI) today announced its unaudited financial and operating results for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026.
